description: Control with a contract-first instruction after the task: state the contract, test it, then implement.
promptSuffix: Work contract-first. Before you change any code, write down the contract of the code you will touch: its inputs and outputs, the invariants it keeps and its error cases, as types and a short comment where they belong. Then write tests that check that contract, including the edge cases it names, and only after that change the implementation until they pass.
